info.title: Pmad.CodeCondenser - Static analysis tool for C# clone detection and comment summarization
info.description: Roslyn-based static analysis CLI tool to detect C# code clones and condense verbose comments via local LLMs.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze C# codebase in dry-run mode (default)

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply summarized comments directly to source files on disk

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Install or update AI agent skills in the workspace (.agents/skills)

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Create or refresh the snapshot baseline

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write shortened comments directly to source files

options.name: --incremental
options.description: Use snapshot cache to analyze only modified or new files

options.name: --update-snapshot
options.description: Refresh the snapshot baseline

options.name: --comment-tolerance
options.description: Maximum new verbose comments tolerated in incremental mode

options.name: --summary
options.description: Comment summary mode: disabled, summarize, or report (default: summarize if LLM configured, report otherwise)

options.name: --report-only
options.description: Report-only mode for comments without calling an LLM

options.name: --no-comments
options.description: Disable comment extraction and summarization (alias for --summary disabled)

options.name: --no-duplication
options.description: Disable structural code clone detection

options.name: --sub-method-clones
options.description: Enable sliding-window sub-method clone detection

options.name: --threshold-statements
options.description: Minimum statements for clone detection (default: 8)

options.name: --threshold-comments
options.description: Minimum character length for verbose comments (default: 100)

options.name: --threshold-xml-param
options.description: Minimum content length for XML param (default: threshold-comments / 2)

options.name: --max-line-length
options.description: Maximum line length for formatted comments (default: 120)

options.name: --model
options.description: Specify LLM model name (default: gemma4:e4b)

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Specify Ollama endpoint URL (default: http://localhost:11434)

options.name: --context-size
options.description: Specify context window size in tokens (default: 24576)

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to custom codecondenser.json configuration file

options.name: --no-global-config
options.description: Disable loading of global user profile configuration

options.name: --include
options.description: Add glob pattern of files/directories to include

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Add glob pattern of files/directories to exclude

options.name: --exclude-tests
options.description: Completely exclude test files (alias: --production-only)

options.name: --enforce-test-duplication
options.description: Treat test clones as CI policy violation in gate check

options.name: --include-generated
options.description: Disable automatic exclusion of generated files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview actions without modifying files on disk

options.name: --force
options.description: Force overwrite skill files even if up to date

options.name: --clean
options.description: Remove obsolete files from skill directories

options.name: --skill
options.description: Specify a specific skill to install/update (default: all bundled skills)

options.name: --skills-dir
options.description: Override target skills directory (default: <workspace>/.agents/skills)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, sarif, json (default: console)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (default: stdout)

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI color formatting

options.name: --help
options.description: Show command line help and options

options.name: --version
options.description: Show application version
